steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Where... am I? Hecate... dummy...?
Hella gradually opens her eyes, and though the streets of Syndicate are momentarily disorienting, she quickly recognizes the face of the woman driving beside her.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: You are finally awake! The shackles are much stronger after ${PlayerName} woke up.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: The Black Ring has already encroached upon the outskirts of Drifter Camp; we need to get out of here.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Before that, I'll drive you back to MBCC. Your health is improving, and there's no need to worry about anything else. ${PlayerName} has returned too, everything is going to be okay.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I'll ensure you get back—Ugh!!

A fierce impact, and the collapsing wall obstructs their way. Lavina unfastens her seatbelt, assisting Hella in their escape. Her leg injury is far from recovered, and she hasn't taken more than a few steps before the Corruptors catch up. Lavina has to open fire to fend them off.
They eventually take shelter in the gaps amidst the rubble. Lavina tensely retrieves a vial of medicine to tend to Hella's contamination, as she has also suffered many injuries.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Huff huff... We're in the clear. Let's rest here for a moment.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I can handle these enemies. Just hold on a little longer; I won't let you be in danger again.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Am I holding you back? I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Don't apologize!

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: No need to apologize to me...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Just think of me as the one seeking redemption... I'm the one who's guilty...
Painful memories start resurfacing, causing her voice to lower and quiver slightly.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: In March, after ${PlayerName} returned to Drifter Camp, I, a logistics officer, also picked up a weapon and took to the streets, joining the riot.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Matilda says that at that time, the shackles within me had already been corrupted by Corpus, it's the mania that twisted me.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: But deep down, I know it's not the answer...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I've always considered revenge as my only course because those monsters took my daughter away, and I couldn't even have her remains. There hasn't been a single day in all these years that I could forget, nor a night without nightmares.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I keep reminding myself: Sophie sacrificed herself for her ideals. Her name is etched on the monument, making her a true hero. She must have been immensely proud of herself, and so am I... proud of my heroic daughter. That's what I've always believed.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Until the moment I witnessed ${PlayerName} being brought back to Drifter Camp...
[Remembering Chief's Death]

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: The leader of the Rustfire, a hero... heh...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: That appearance, where is the hero in that?!

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: His slender frame is full of scars, his clothes stained dark with blood, fingernails split and broken... What pride? What vanity? I can't see these emotions on his face. He is in torment, resisting, not ready to let go of his life!
steps.female_content: Her slender frame is full of scars, her clothes stained dark with blood, fingernails split and broken... What pride? What vanity? I can't see these emotions on her face. She is in torment, resisting, not ready to let go of her life!

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: My daughter had no wish to die when she was murdered! They've endured such agony, perishing in the bleakest spots at the prime of their lives!
Her rage flares up for a fleeting moment, like a toxic wave flooding out of her, but she snaps back to reality, regretting that brief loss of self-control intensely.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Since then, whenever I armed myself, I lost control. I had no clue what I had done, no memory of it at all. I had let myself be completely consumed by hatred...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I only snapped out of it when I saw one of my "companions" going after a kid, and saw it was you.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: ...What have we become, doing this to a kid, even younger than Sophie?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: How did I end up like this, why did things go so far? The same suffering Sophie went through, I made you endure. I'm no better than the devils of Nirvana...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I am beyond redemption. I don't deserve your forgiveness...
Hella listened quietly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I see now... All of Lavina's actions, they were all for her daughter... It all makes sense now...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You really had those Rustfire troublemakers eating out of your hand, always on the ball and super efficient. You take care of everyone so thoughtfully, plus... your pancakes taste like the best thing in the world.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can still recall... just before I blacked out, ${PlayerName} was gone, and there was Hecate, out on the streets, trying to be a hero.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: There were loads of crazies on the other side. I thought, if I went down fighting for my friends, that would be the bravest thing. Friends have always meant everything to me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But at that moment, you showed up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: As I was nearly at my limit, you fought your way through the crowd, yelling and shoving them aside. When shoving wasn't enough, you dove over me to shield me. You yelled so hard you lost your voice.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: In an instant, my courage just evaporated. I was so scared, I couldn't let go, dared not to even peek outside. All I wanted was to hold onto you tightly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's such a strange feeling... I, the Rat Queen of Syndicate, have always been the one stepping up, looking out for others. Never once did I rely on someone else to protect me. When did I turn so cowardly, so worthless... Lying down for so long, it doesn't make any sense...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But now I get it...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The one who stepped in to save me back then was a "mother."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I had no mom and dad. Before I made any friends, it was just me, making my way through Syndicate. I never really understood what others meant when they talked about a "mother."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: In your embrace, my mind was filled with—

She leaves her sentence hanging, gently wiping the tears off the woman's face. Lavina's arms are a map of scars, and her back must have been worse. At that moment, she clang to Hella, bearing the brunt of a relentless attack for what seems like an eternity.
The embrace feels warm. Hella holds on a bit tighter before softly pushing her away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...But my actual mom left me behind ages ago.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You aren't my mom.

Hella picks up her battered pipe, presses down on Lavina's hand to rise, and gazes out at the street. The surging Corruptors, howling in the distance, attracted by the shackles, are inevitably coming. She stands and moves outwards.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: No, you mustn't go! Stay here! Wait for me—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You aren't as strong as I am, aren't used to being a Sinner, aren't used to the shackles. Not seasoned by the world as I am, nor familiar with the corners of Syndicate. You can't shield me from anything.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yet, you've opened my eyes to wonders I never knew existed.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stay put, Lavina, you're not the one who can protect me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I should be the one protecting you.

She steps forward to confront the raging Corruptors. In the depths of her soul, beyond the shackles, there are no comforting allies, only the Black Ring in her eyes, in her thoughts, the terror that had plagued her sleep for eight months gripping her throat.
And the root of all this? Syndicate, a world where even a "mother" can be twisted into a monster.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****... Ninety-nine, Hecate, and...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That dummy ${PlayerName}...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm really starting to miss you all...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I wish I was strong like you guys...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why am I this weak...
She fights back tears, inhaling deeply to calm her shaking hands.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bring it on, you bunch of losers! I can take on all of you!
